items.title: Lennox (LII) Stock Could Trade Below Fair Value On Cash Flow
items.summary: Lennox International has seen its share price fall sharply over the year, which naturally puts the spotlight on whether the current valuation is still supported by the cash the business can generate. With the stock now trading around US$349.97, the key issue is how that market price stacks up against the cash flow profile implied by a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) view. items.title: 1 industrials stock with exciting potential and 2 we brush off
items.summary: Industrials businesses quietly power the physical things we depend on, from cars and homes to e-commerce infrastructure. Unfortunately, this role also comes with a demand profile tethered to the ebbs and flows of the broader economy, and investors seem to be forecasting a downturn - over the past six months, the industry has pulled back by 7.9%. This drawdown is a stark contrast from the S&P 500’s 7.2% gain.
